name: ken-ai
description: Ken AI skills: build cold email campaigns, handle replies, report results and keep sending healthy in your Ken workspace, through the Ken MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Run your Ken workspace: campaigns, replies, reports and deliverability
interface.longDescription: The skills Ken's own agents run, for your Ken workspace: build a campaign from an ICP to launch-ready, handle replies, review your pipeline, write client reports and keep sending healthy. The plugin connects the Ken MCP server (https://mcp.ken.so/mcp); sign in with your Ken account on first use. Each skill asks before it sends, launches or changes a live campaign.
defaultPrompt: Build a new cold email campaign in my Ken workspace
Go through my Ken replies and draft answers for me to approve
